jobs.title: Junior Product Manager - AI-Driven Ops & Automations
jobs.why: Excellent bridge from business systems and operations into product. The role maps real workflows, identifies process gaps, writes specs and requirements, prototypes AI-driven automations, builds dashboards, owns SOPs, and runs rollouts and adoption with operations and engineering teams.
jobs.gap: Audrey should show hands-on use of AI/automation tools and quantify process improvements. SQL/BI is a plus, so she should emphasize adjacent analytics experience rather than overstate technical depth.

jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst
jobs.location: New York, NY (Hybrid / 4-5 days in office)
jobs.why: Strong fit for Audrey's operations and media background. The role combines cross-functional project leadership, analytics, process improvement, executive-ready communication, milestone tracking, and work across revenue, product, and financial data; adtech/digital-media experience is explicitly preferred.
jobs.gap: The role partners directly with the CEO and expects polished executive presentations plus 2-4 years of execution-heavy experience. Audrey should foreground media/adtech context, project ownership, and measurable cross-functional outcomes.

jobs.title: Product Operations Analyst
jobs.why: Strong product-operations match centered on discovery, translating painful workflows into buildable solutions, managing delivery in Linear, coordinating with engineering, testing before launch, and communicating technical tradeoffs to customers.
jobs.gap: The AI-agent product requires comfort discussing connectors, data pipelines, reliability, and AI failure modes. Audrey should emphasize UAT/testing, requirements translation, system implementation, and technical stakeholder communication.

jobs.title: Product Operations
jobs.why: High-upside product-operations role with a strong emphasis on ownership, adaptability, cross-team coordination, eliminating inefficiencies, and ensuring product work stays connected to customers and business outcomes.
jobs.gap: This is the stretch role in today's batch: compensation and the highly technical RF/AI environment suggest a demanding bar, and the posting includes ITAR eligibility requirements. Audrey should prioritize the first three roles before this one.
